22:1: O people, beware of your Rabb; surely the earthquake of that Hour is a tremendous thing.
22:2: On the day you see it, every nursing woman forgets what she nurses, every pregnant woman drops her burden, and you see people drunk, whereas they are not drunk, but the punishment of Allah is severe.
22:3: And among the people is he who disputes about Allah without knowledge, and follows every rebellious devil.
22:4: It has been written upon him that whoever takes him as an ally, he leads him astray and guides him to the blazing punishment.
22:5: O people, if you are in a doubt about the resurrection, surely We created you from dust, then from a nutfah, then from an alaqah, then from a formed and unformed lump of flesh so that We make clear to you. And We keep in the wombs what We will until an appointed term. Then We bring you out as a baby. Then so that you reach your age of maturity. And of you is he who dies, and of you is he who is returned to the most abject of life so that after knowledge he knows nothing. And you see the earth dead. But when We send down water upon it, it stirs, swells, and grows from every beautiful pair.
22:6: That is because Allah is the Truth, and He revives the dead, and He has power over all things.
22:7: And that the Hour is coming is certain, there is no doubt in it, and Allah will resurrect those who are in the graves.
22:8: And of the people is he who disputes about Allah without knowledge, without a guide, and without an illuminating book,
22:9: Bending his neck to lead astray from the way of Allah; for him there is disgrace in the world, and on the Day of Resurrection We will make him taste the burning punishment.
22:10: That is because of what your hands have sent forth, and surely Allah is not an oppressor to the servants.
22:11: And of the people is he who serves Allah on an edge. If a good befalls him, he is reassured by it. If a trial befalls him, he turns on his face. He has lost the world and the hereafter. That is the manifest loss.
22:12: Besides Allah, he calls upon things that do not harm him and do not benefit him. That is the distant misguidance.
22:13: He calls upon one whose harm is closer than his benefit. What an evil protector and what an evil companion!
22:14: Surely Allah admits those who believe and do righteous deeds into gardens beneath which rivers flow. Surely Allah does what He wills.
22:15: Whoever thinks that Allah will not help him in the world and the hereafter, let him stretch a rope to the sky, then cut, then see: will his plot remove what enrages him?
22:16: And thus We sent it down as clear verses. And surely Allah guides whom He wills.
22:17: Surely those who believe, the Jews, the Sabians, the Christians, the Magians, and those who associate partners; surely Allah will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection. Surely Allah is witness over all things.
22:18: Did you not see that whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth, the sun, the moon, the stars, the mountains, the trees, the living creatures, and many of the people prostrate to Allah? And upon many the punishment has become due. And whomever Allah humiliates, there is no one to honor him. Surely Allah does what He wills.
22:19: These are two adversaries who dispute about their Rabb. For those who disbelieve, garments of fire have been cut out; boiling water is poured over their heads.
22:20: With it, what is in their bellies and the skins are melted.
22:21: And for them are whips of iron.
22:22: Whenever they want to come out from there because of anguish, they are returned back into it, and to them it is said: 'Taste the burning punishment.'
22:23: Surely Allah puts those who believe and do righteous deeds into gardens beneath which rivers flow; there they are adorned with bracelets of gold and pearls, and their garments are silk.
22:24: And they have been guided to the best of speech and directed to the path of the Praised One.
22:25: Surely those who disbelieve and hinder from the way of Allah and from al-Masjid al-Haram, which We have made equal for people—for the resident therein and the visitor—and whoever intends therein deviation with injustice, We will make him taste a painful punishment.
22:26: And when We prepared for Abraham the place of the House, and said: 'Do not associate anything with Me, and purify My House for those who perform tawaf, those who stand in qiyam, those who bow in ruku, and those who prostrate in sujud.'
22:27: And proclaim the hajj among the people so that they come to you on foot and upon every lean camel coming from every distant path,
22:28: That they may witness benefits for themselves and mention the name of Allah on appointed days over the animals He has provided them as sustenance. So eat of them and feed the distressed poor.
22:29: Then let them remove their dirt, fulfill their vows, and perform tawaf around the Ancient House.
22:30: That is so. Whoever respects the sacred things of Allah, it is better for him in the presence of his Rabb. And cattle have been made lawful to you, except what is recited to you. So avoid the filth of idols and avoid false speech,
22:31: Being hanifs to Allah, not associating partners with Him. And whoever associates partners with Allah, it is as if he fell from the sky and the birds snatched him away or the wind blew him away to a distant place.
22:32: That is it. Whoever exalts the symbols of Allah, surely that is from the piety of the hearts.
22:33: For you in them are benefits until an appointed term, then their place of sacrifice is the Ancient House (Bayt al-Atiq).
22:34: And for every community We appointed a place of worship so that they mention the name of Allah over the animals He provided them as sustenance. Your God is one God, so submit to Him. And give good tidings to those who humbly submit from the heart,
22:35: Those whose hearts tremble when Allah is mentioned, who are patient over what befalls them, who establish the prayer (salah), and who spend out of what We have provided them.
22:36: And the camels We have made for you among the symbols of Allah; for you in them is good, so mention the name of Allah over them while they are lined up in ranks. When their flanks fall down, eat of them and feed both the contented and the beggar. Thus We have subjected them to you so that you may give thanks.
22:37: Their meats and their blood never reach Allah, but piety (taqwa) from you reaches Him. Thus He subjected them to you so that you may magnify Allah for what He guided you to. And give good tidings to the doers of good.
22:38: Surely Allah defends those who believe. Surely Allah does not love any treacherous, ungrateful one.
22:39: Permission has been given to those who are fought against, because they have been wronged. And surely Allah is certainly capable of helping them.
22:40: They were expelled from their homes unjustly, only because they said, 'Our Rabb is Allah.' If Allah had not repelled some of the people by means of others, monasteries, churches, synagogues, and masjids in which the name of Allah is mentioned much would surely have been demolished. Allah certainly helps the one who helps Him. Indeed, Allah is very strong, very exalted.
22:41: Those who, if We establish them in power on the earth, establish salah, give zakat, enjoin goodness, and forbid evil.
22:42: And if they deny you, before them the people of Noah, Ad, and the people of Thamud also denied,
22:43: And the people of Abraham and the people of Lot,
22:44: And the people of Midian too. Moses was denied. And I granted respite to the disbelievers, then I seized them. How then was My punishment?
22:45: How many towns We destroyed while they were doing wrong, and now their roofs have collapsed, their wells are abandoned, and their lofty palaces are left completely empty.
22:46: Have they not traveled through the earth so that they would have hearts to understand with or ears to hear with? For indeed, eyes do not become blind, but the hearts that are in the breasts become blind.
22:47: They ask you to hasten the punishment, and Allah never breaks His promise. Indeed, a day in the presence of your Rabb is like a thousand years of what you count.
22:48: How many towns I granted respite to while they were doing wrong, then I seized them. The return is to Me.
22:49: Say: "O people, I am for you only a clear warner."
22:50: For those who believe and do righteous deeds, there is forgiveness and a generous provision.
22:51: And those who strive to cause failure to Our verses, those are the companions of Hell.
22:52: We did not send before you any messenger or prophet but that when he longed for something, Satan cast something into his longing. Then Allah removes what Satan casts, then establishes His verses firmly. And Allah is All-Knowing, Possessor of judgment and wisdom.
22:53: So that He may make what Satan casts a trial for those in whose hearts is a disease and whose hearts are hardened. Indeed, the wrongdoers are certainly in a far division.
22:54: And that those who were given knowledge may know that it is the truth from your Rabb, so that they may believe in it and their hearts may submit to it. And indeed, Allah guides those who believe to a straight path.
22:55: And those who disbelieve continue in doubt concerning it, until the Hour comes to them suddenly or the punishment of a barren day comes to them.
22:56: On that Day, the sovereignty belongs to Allah; He judges between them; those who believe and do righteous deeds are in the gardens of delight.
22:57: And those who disbelieve and deny Our verses, for those there is a humiliating punishment.
22:58: As for those who emigrated in the cause of Allah, then were killed or died, Allah will surely provide them with a good provision. Indeed, Allah is the best of providers.
22:59: By oath, He will certainly admit them into a place with which they will be pleased. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, al-Halim (Most Forbearing).
22:60: That is so. Whoever retaliates with the like of what was done to him, and then is wronged, Allah will surely help him.
22:61: That is so: Allah merges the night into the day and merges the day into the night, and indeed Allah is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.
22:62: That is because Allah is the truth and what they invoke besides Him is falsehood, and indeed Allah is the Exalted, the Great.
22:63: Did you not see that Allah sends down water from the sky and the earth becomes lush green? Indeed, Allah is al-Latif (Most Subtle) and All-Aware.
22:64: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth belongs to Him. Indeed, Allah is certainly the Self-Sufficient and Praiseworthy.
22:65: Did you not see that Allah subjected to you whatever is on the earth and the ships that run through the sea by His command, and He holds the sky from falling upon the earth except with His permission?
22:66: And it is He who gave you life, then causes you to die, then will give you life again. Indeed, man is very ungrateful.
22:67: For every community We appointed a rite of worship that they observe. So let them not dispute with you in this matter, and call to your Rabb. Indeed, you are upon a straight guidance.
22:68: If they dispute with you, say: Allah knows best what you do.
22:69: Allah will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which you used to differ.
22:70: Do you not know that Allah knows what is in the sky and on the earth? Indeed, this is in a book. Indeed, this is easy for Allah.
22:71: They worship besides Allah that for which He has sent down no authority and of which they have no knowledge, and for the wrongdoers there is no helper.
22:72: When Our verses are recited to them clearly, you recognize evil in the faces of those who disbelieve; they almost assault those who recite Our verses to them. Say: Shall I inform you of worse than this? The Fire! Allah promised it to those who disbelieve. What an evil destination it is.
22:73: O people, an example has been presented, so listen to it now. Indeed, those you invoke besides Allah can never create even a fly, even if they gathered together for it. And if the fly should snatch something away from them, they could not rescue it from it. Feeble are both the seeker and the sought.
22:74: They did not appraise Allah with His true appraisal. Indeed, Allah is very strong, very exalted.
22:75: Allah chooses messengers from the angels and from the people. Indeed, Allah is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.
22:76: He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and all matters are returned to Allah.
22:77: O you who believe, bow down (ruku) and prostrate (sujud) and worship your Rabb and do good, that you may reach salvation.
22:78: And strive in the cause of Allah with the striving due to Him. He chose you and placed no difficulty upon you in religion. It is the religion of your father Abraham. He named you Muslims before and in this, so that the Messenger may be a witness over you and you may be witnesses over the people. So establish salah, give zakat, and hold fast to Allah. He is your Mawla. What an excellent Mawla and what an excellent helper!
